consoles.name: Ship Operations
consoles.description: Set the ship’s speed with the throttle and choose a heading on the radar ring. Monitor nearby contacts while coordinating with the crew.

consoles.name: Helm
consoles.description: Fly using actual propulsion, reserves and approved navigation objectives.

consoles.name: Engineering
consoles.description: Operate generation, incoming allocations, local reserves, conduits and cooling.

consoles.name: Science
consoles.description: Observe the fitted long-range sensor and share selected evidence.

consoles.name: Tactical
consoles.description: Observe the independent local sensor and coordinate ship readiness.

consoles.name: Comms
consoles.description: Review received Coordination and send structured bridge requests.

consoles.name: Captain
consoles.description: Review published objectives, deliberate reports and current delegation.

fields.detail: Review the requested operation and available power/cooling.
